sources.title: Sociedade Taoísta do Brasil – institutional history
sources.quality_notes: Self-reported institutional history, Taiwanese ordination and founding chronology; named Zi Wei Dou Shu among arts. Not contemporaneous proof of Ziwei instruction or lineage.

sources.title: Zi Wei Dou Shu institutional article
sources.quality_notes: Named Portuguese Ziwei description; same institution as history and consultation; no independent lineage.

sources.title: Atendimentos e Consultorias
sources.quality_notes: Ziwei service offering including birth data and natal/period analysis; not delivered consultations or first date.

sources.title: Curso de Fundamentos da Astrologia de 4 Pilares
sources.quality_notes: Aurimar Cerqueira, Sao Paulo, four pillars syllabus; named other systems does not prove Ziwei instruction or actual class delivery.

sources.title: Cosmologia Chinesa
sources.quality_notes: Distinct 80-hour Bazi and 64-hour Ziwei curricula; curriculum classifications not ancient lineage proof.

sources.title: Viento y Agua 2025 guide
sources.provider: Laura M. de Flores / Viento y Agua
sources.quality_notes: Bounded visual pages index 0,1,2,11; author self-reports training and both services; index11 printed p10 contains four pillars and luck pillars, not validated calculation. No complete byte hash or original historical glyph authority.

sources.title: Estudio Zi Wei Dou Shu
sources.quality_notes: Named Ziwei twelve-palace service; Song dating in marketing contradictory. Same provider as guide, no independent lineage.

sources.title: Cursos presenciales
sources.quality_notes: Five-stage Bazi syllabus including hand chart, stems/branches, ten gods and patterns; actual class delivery unverified.

sources.title: Ba Zi los Cuatro Pilares del Destino
sources.quality_notes: ISBN9789707751781/9707751789; 178 pages; Rudolfo spelling and Tomorrow's Guides listing conflict with Rodolfo/Grupo Editorial Tomo/2012 elsewhere. No first imprint or physical edition established.

sources.title: Ba Zi
sources.quality_notes: Author site identifies same-titled book and distinct ancient-style/Ziping teaching claims. Not independent edition or ancient mechanical evidence.

sources.title: Publicaciones – Fórmulas del Feng Shui y de la Astrología China Ba Zi
sources.quality_notes: ISBN9789873910227, 143 pages. Exact issue date and original pages unresolved. Purple Star title elsewhere not automatically Ziwei.

sources.title: Cursos online
sources.quality_notes: Explicit Bazi online course; cross-country Feng Shui network not evidence of Bazi delivery in all countries.

sources.title: Cursos – 4 Pilares / Tzu-Wei Tou-Shu
sources.quality_notes: Four pillars description and named Tzu-Wei title only; no specific Ziwei syllabus, local actual delivery or date.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Institution foundation and ordination do not establish first Ziwei transmission.
Publication and advertised instruction do not establish actual delivery or historical rule identity.
Same provider records and ISBN variants do not multiply independent lineage or physical edition witnesses.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Brazil actual early Ziwei instruction and 2016 Bazi delivery; Mexico imprint, independent apprenticeship and chart mechanics; Argentina imprint and Peru Ziwei syllabus; other Latin American jurisdictions.
